explanationIssues: choiceExplanations[1]: The text marks the choice 正しい, then ends with 「素子内部の損失大小は定格・動作条件にもよるため一律には断定しない」. That undercuts the verdict it just gave, so a learner can't tell whether (1) counts as correct. Fix: keep the premise that this is the exam's general comparison, and state plainly that it is correct because a bipolar transistor needs base current all the time (drive power), while an FET gate draws almost no current. Either delete the hedging sentence or recast it as a side note that doesn't weaken the verdict.

choiceExplanations[2]: The causal link in 「接合形でも逆バイアスのpn接合を介して制御するため、全FETを酸化膜構造とは言わない」 is unclear. The 「でも」 suggests JFETs are just as vulnerable to static, but the sentence gives no reason why. In practice, static vulnerability (gate-oxide breakdown) is mainly a MOS-type problem, and JFETs, whose gate is a pn junction, are less sensitive than MOSFETs. Fix: say the exam statement is a general comparison dominated by MOS-type FETs, and drop the wording that treats JFETs as equally vulnerable or imply it through the connective.

choiceExplanations[5]: 「キャリアの多数・少数はnpn/pnpの領域によって変わるため一律に割り当てない」 reads like an editing note and doesn't explain the choice. Replace it with the actual reason the statement is correct: bipolar = two carrier types (the origin of the name 'bipolar'), FET = one carrier type (unipolar).
